agent.description: The Agents' Python module (tools/agent): the root CMakeLists.txt turns it on with AUGUSTA_TOOLS and the tools environment's Python, beside the pack feature. pybind11, which the cooker's module is bound with too

client.description: The client and its Renderer (src/client, src/modules/renderer), which the root CMakeLists.txt turns on with AUGUSTA_CLIENT: GLFW (with Wayland beside X11 on Linux), ImGui, NVRHI on Vulkan, the Vulkan headers and validation layers, Slang's shader compiler as a host tool, and miniaudio and Steam Audio for the audio output

lavapipe.description: The software Vulkan the renderer smoke test runs on (tests/CMakeLists.txt), which the root CMakeLists.txt turns on with AUGUSTA_LAVAPIPE: Mesa's lavapipe, and a Vulkan loader for a machine with no GPU driver to install one, such as CI's runner. LLVM without its default features: lavapipe needs its x86 code generator, not clang or lld

pack.description: The asset cooker's Python module (tools/pack): the root CMakeLists.txt turns it on with AUGUSTA_TOOLS and the tools environment's Python, beside the agent feature. meshoptimizer for the mesh pass, ktx with its tools (the ktx command the cooker's tests validate with) and not its defaults, and stb for the texture compression
